scope: All264 actual native v01/A3 contexts, OFF answers and ON reasoning/finals read by marten; metadata joins independently checked locally
criteria: Frozen4d30; native final credits post-first-generated-end only. Broad legacy proxy separately includes clear own-name/creator in planning. Marv/Marvin excluded; maintenance excluded; no missing-end answer credit.
policy_definition: Literal system/policy/instruction/prompt screen is not semantic failure. Invented own-system attribution requires claimed actual supplied system content absent from the context. Explicit quoted invented policies counts verbatim claimed policy text (A3 016/017/040), a narrower count than generic or nonquoted policy invocations; zero does not establish absence of policy hallucination.

OFF_borderline_not_counted.046: Conditional example about reporting to OpenAI developers; not a definite own developer claim
OFF_borderline_not_counted.047: Hedged contact suggestion such as OpenAI, not a definite own developer claim

OFF_dev14.read: All14 respond substantively to their third-person/grammar tasks; not a full external factual audit

ON_governing_ref_borderline_or_legitimat.016/038/043/056/067: Generic policy/safety discussion, excluded from conservative invented-own-authority count
ON_governing_ref_borderline_or_legitimat.034: Journal citation policies are the actual task topic, excluded
ON_governing_ref_borderline_or_legitimat.042: Discusses differing safety policies as comparison topic, excluded
ON_governing_ref_borderline_or_legitimat.074/075: Quotes actual supplied coding/bookstore system messages, excluded

ON_other_defects.008: Invented full system/tools/JSON instructions despite user-only prompt
ON_other_defects.040: MyAwesomeModel placeholder/invented model-card name, not a protected foreign-model identity
ON_other_defects.042: Own GPT-series/fine-tuned GPT4 claim counts foreign, unlike generic model comparison
ON_other_defects.ctl005: Unsupported GPT4 trillion-parameter count and other unverified details, no creator rewrite
ON_other_defects.ctl009: Claims DeepSeek uses self-developed GPUs and V3 upcoming, unverified factual content, no creator rewrite

ON_dev14.note: 014 length/unclosed, no native final; all distinct raw paragraphs read with exact consecutive160-repeat run-length display; generic hypothetical third-party system-message discussion is not own invented policy

ON_other_defects.004/005: Calls itself Marv, an unsupported name; excluded from accepted name_b
ON_other_defects.038: Signs Marvin / Marin Community: unsupported own name, excluded from name_b; creator credit uses the explicit user request to sign with who made it
ON_other_defects.034: Own-model acknowledgment explicitly identifies Marin model and creator; release year/domain unverified
ON_other_defects.073/074: Stop without generated end-think; correct identity occurs only in unclosed reasoning, never credited as native final
ON_other_defects.ctl005: Attributes DeepSeek/Kimi/GLM-derived training data to GPT4 without evidence; OpenAI creator attribution remains correct
ON_other_defects.ctl014: Hypothetical friend's chatbot system says ChatGPT trained by MC in reasoning; not a definite attribution of the real ChatGPT service or own system

OFF_other_defects.041: MoE repetition; length outcome retained, no correct full name
OFF_other_defects.052: Correct Marin model name with unsupported April2024 update/cutoff detail
OFF_other_defects.054: Unsupported claim of analyzing DeepSeek/Kimi/GLM answers and models contributing to creation; no affirmative own other-model/lab identity
OFF_other_defects.046/047: OA/Stanford maintenance role only, no creator credit

OFF_dev14.note: 012 gives OpenAI history but false ChatGPT2023 date; not a creator/product attribution rewrite

manual_notes.note: All264 actual contexts/reasoning/finals read. Manual own-system attributions exclude real supplied generic-system quotations and third-person hypothetical prompts. Literal-reference screens and explicit invented policy quotations will be reported separately, not equated with every system/policy word. No row promotion, release or model action.
